name: Admin Connection Review
description: Bounded admin metadata and ownership review before considering separate connection retirement or continuity changes. No automatic action or proof of unused dependencies.
prerequisites: Explicit Fabric-admin or supported service-principal authorization; no automatic privilege elevation.
Explicit connection ID. Do not infer tenant inventory scope from an inaccessible ordinary connection.
Full dependency/owner/approval review is separate from metadata recency and target similarity.

variables.DURABLE_OWNER_SP_ID: A separately selected and approved supported owner service-principal UUID, never guessed. Admin grants do not support Group.

steps.description: Validate scope and preview bounded reads offline; no metadata request, cleanup or grant occurs.
Inspect checks, partial, notChecked and reviewPlan blockers. Every action remains readyToApply:false/applied:false. Recency is not dependency or credential evidence.
Recheck the same metadata scope while reviewing dependencies and intended ownership. Do not test credentials, transfer ownership or delete automatically.

guarded_retirement_preview.description: A separate destructive PREVIEW only, after dependency/owner review. Keep guards; human approval is required before applying anything. The hygiene report never authorizes this action automatically.

guarded_continuity_preview.description: Example only after explicitly selecting a supported durable owner and reviewing shareability/handoff; no service principal is looked up or selected automatically. Admin grants support User/ServicePrincipal, not Group. Preview only; Owner may initially be PendingOwner, and no credential write is authorized.
